mappings.reason: Adjusting a qualified loop against measured response applies the existing feedback-analysis mechanism; analog and digital implementations retain actual plant and controller constraints.
Maintaining timing relationships for a control application uses the shared distributed-timing mechanism; task-specific tolerances do not create a separate clock technology.

scope_distinctions.distinction: A differential gain stage, reusable high-gain feedback block and qualified high-input-impedance measurement interface have distinct circuit roles; common components should not be duplicated in production.
Tracing reachability, tracking references and checking ownership/lifetimes handle memory differently, with different resource and correctness limits.
Classical superconducting logic is not a universal prerequisite for quantum devices. Different qubit implementations require distinct physical operating environments.
Manual spatial counters, mechanical positional carrying and stored-program operand stacks are different computation mechanisms, not mandatory consecutive eras.
